name: chip-select
title: Chip select
description: Choose from a wrapping set of chips, one or several, with a check on the chosen ones, a minimum and maximum, and a spoken count that says why the rest turn off.
docs: mode="single" (the default) takes value as a string or null and reports the chip that was chosen; mode="multiple" takes and reports an array of values, always in the order of the chips. With max, the chips that are not chosen turn off once the limit is reached and the polite line under the chips says why ("Pick up to 5, 5 chosen"). With min the same line states the rule ("Pick at least 3"), and a shortfall turns into an error once the group has been left or a form with it is submitted: the browser's own bubble is cancelled, focus goes to the first chip and the line becomes the error. error shows a message from outside, labels.hint rewrites the line for another language, and name sends the choice with a plain form (one hidden input per value, or a radio in single mode). An icon is an element such as <IconStar />; a chosen chip swaps it for its check. Chips are 36px tall, with a 44px touch target on touch screens.
